name: The Dragonspire
source:
Welcome to the Realm of Dragonspire...

You're Stephen (the Male Protagonist's default name), head of the private security firm Dragonspire Security Force (The DSF). It is set in a Dark modern world with a massive surprise to Fantasy, including Scandals, Corruption, Death, Tough Choices, and entire Character Progression while the shape of the world around you changes. Do you adapt or succumb to it? Most notably, The romance you will experience along the way will be rewarding and have an in-depth storyline. It is up to you if you settle down or check all your options. The choices you make will dictate the outcome of the story. Will you guide his path to the Light or succumb to the existing and growing corruption?

[From Official Discord]
translation:
欢迎来到龙之塔国度…

你是斯蒂芬（男主角的默认名字），私人保安公司龙尖安全部队（DSF）的负责人。它以黑暗的现代世界为背景，给幻想带来了巨大的惊喜，包括丑闻、腐败、死亡、艰难的选择，以及整个角色的发展，而你周围的世界的形状却发生了变化。你适应还是屈服于它？最值得注意的是，你一路上经历的浪漫将会是有益的，并且有深入的故事情节。你是否安定下来或检查所有选择都取决于你。你所做的选择将决定故事的结果。你会引导他走向光明之路，还是屈服于现有且日益增长的腐败？

[来自官方不和谐]
